title.narrative: Meaningful access to Senior Centre for elderly people in Syunik, Armenia

description.narrative:
A notable part (18%) out of the over 100,000 people displaced from Nagorno-Karabagh in 2023 comprises elderly people, and among them, 8% are either single elderly individuals or people with disabilities. The primary focus of the project is on the 100 elderly people who have been displaced from Nagorno-Karabagh and are currently residing in the Goris enlarged community. These individuals face geriatric challenges, and require support in terms of socialization and communication. The project¿s beneficiaries will receive a range of social services including mobility assistance for the elderly, hygiene support, light meals, and the organization of various entertainment activities.

The elderly will spend their days in a cosy and convivial atmosphere, engaging in communication and social interactions. Coordinators at the centre will adeptly plan and oversee daily activities which encompass visits to neighbouring community cultural centres, event organizations and film screenings. Additionally, a nurse will be available to provide primary health care services and necessary medications tailored to the specific needs of the beneficiaries, and refer them to the relevant service centres for them to receive assistive devices when needed.

Volunteers will work alongside the centre staff, assisting in providing hygienic care for the beneficiaries and organizing public and entertainment events such as laundry services, ironing, hairdressing, and more. They will also facilitate the transportation of beneficiaries to medical and social institutions, providing necessary accompaniment.
